rows.text: Downloaded Nova Launcher as an alternative. Still not used to not having the navigation buttons at the bottom; the gesture to pull the app drawer & recent items are too close together so I often activate the wrong feature. • RAM: 4GB makes it run smoothly but it would have been nice to have 6GB at this price point. My Xperia XZ3 had 6GB or RAM & I would consistently have over 50% free but the Pixel tends to always use @ least 60%. • Cameras: Seems odd to only have 1 back camera nowadays but it works great. • Screen: The colors & PPI look good but the notch does seem unnecessarily deep.

Flawed but still great. I have a love/hate relationship with my Pixel 3 XL. The camera is by a wide margin the best on any smartphone beating out the best iPhone and Samsung handsets. The thoughtful touches to Android Pie like dynamic notifications, digital wellbeing, and customization options are all very useful. I honestly really like the active edge and find myself squeezing to bring up the assistant all the time. The battery life though, is poor to put it nicely and 4gb of RAM in this day and age is just not acceptable. The Pixel 2 had 4gb and the new Galaxy S10+ has 8gb of RAM. Because of this bad decision, apps sometimes crash or restart. Sometimes the whole phone freezes and only a hard reset fixes everything. Overall I expected better for a premium flagship phone and Google dropped the ball on what should have been a home run.

Started fine, but eventually stopped working. For the first year or so, aside from having a battery life that only lasted for a few hours even at full charge, the phone worked alright. However, after the first year, apps would start freezing randomly and eventually get to the point that it would just turn off altogether Sometimes, even during a phone call, my phone would lag out, and then eventually turn off and immediately boot back up. This also conveniently started happening right after the one year google warranty ended. I would look elsewhere.

Wifi didn't turn on and stock apps crashed.. The phone seemed brand new appearance wise but completely unusable as I was not able to connect to the Wifi. The Wifi would not turn on to search for a network. I troubleshooted various ways several times and even talked with a Google tech support rep. It ran a bit slow and the stock apps crashed a few times such as the 'settings' app. It came with Android 11 pre installed and although the phone itself looked new , it was having issues with the software.

Anyway, the phone is working now but battery performance isn't great, I have it just sitting on the counter and I haven't done anything with it, no call, no texts, no nothing, and in 4 hours time it is down to 46%, which is all kinds of BAD! Anyway, I think I need to check the batteries performance level because my old pixel 3 xl which I have sitting next to this renewed phone is at 82% running the same apps as this renewed phone. Yeah, I am thinking I just a renewed phone that was heavily used and the battery can't hold a very good charge anymore!

All together I have well over 100 apps. After having a couple of weeks to get all of my apps up and running, all of my maps downloaded onto the device etc it shows I have 12 gigs even of system usage for the operating system and a total of 25 gigs used. So in short I have 100 free gigs to allow my device to perform like a rocket ship. This sucker is fast. Spend the extra money and get the extra storage space. I've always used 64 GB hard drives with a 128 GB SD card and it always ends up slowing down on me. This beast of a pixel performs so much better and since the operating system is small and not filled with bloatware expect to have about 100 gigs free.
Great Pixel Experience!. Looking at benchmark scores, I was scared this phone would be slow and not good. However, this phone EXCEEDS expectation for an Android! 9.5/10

Right after the return window it gets buggy. Apps have started to stop responding, and the phone has really slowed down. Looked up when I purchased, and of course we're 2 weeks after the return window. I run my phone pretty light - with few installed apps and most things through the browser, so I'm a little bummed even lightweight apps have crashed (e.g., slack, voice recorder).

Great Phone. This is a great phone for the money. Its practically brand new. I bought it as a backup phone and its looking like its going to be my everyday phone. I love it! **update** I've had this phone for 3 days now. It flawless and its very fast. The speakers and the camera are excellent. I can't say anything bad about this phone. Even though it's renowned, the phone is in excellent conditions.

I know this is with any device since it needs to update and do routine things, but 2/7 days of the week my phone will be at 80% (~10% at end of shift) in the hour it takes to get to work, while other days it will be at 95%. According the battery manager nothing is hogging the juice. 4) The screen is fairly useless in direct sunlight 5) 3gigs of ram will bog you WAY down But to be honest I am sad to get rid of this phone. Its amazing (que run on sentence).

Super. Bought refurbished. There might be some scratches or whatever, but I haven't noticed any. Phone itself works great and fast. 4gb ram is lower than most other phones, but I haven't noticed any downside. If it does have to reload an app due to low ram, it does it quickly enough that it is not really an issue.

Don't buy. My son needed a new play phone. (games and such) my daughter and I have this phone and decided it'd be a good phone for my 5 year old. It always disconnects from wifi. If you even try to go into settings it freezes everytime. This phone is pretty much a paper weight.
Corrupted, unreliable. Phone repeatedly freezes on a daily basis and comes up with a device corrupted error screen. Google support has been unwilling to fix the issue.

Just inside your price range, pal.. Phenomenal phone. I can't bog it down with multiple apps and games. It's pretty dang good, with an all day battery using it for navigation and contacting customers.

I put the game on Epic settings at max resolution and it stayed a solid 60 Hertz! Highly recommend if your a mobile gamer and want to run games at max settings. It also goes up to Android 12 which is an awesome OS for ease of use and device customization flexiblity. A great phone deserves a second chance. This easily gets 5 stars.

But all in all Pixel 3 XL does a better job in this area, hands down. Battery: I use my phone a lot, work, social networking & playing games ( PUBG & FIFA anyone?!) so if the battery can last a day with me, it should do the same with you as well! I did feel that the note 9 battery lasted slightly longer though & Samsung gives you a couple of options for battery saving that are not that invasive & still let you use the phone while saving some juice, so Note 9 wins the battery. Software: FINALLY a phone that feels different! In a very good way! it took me some time( just a day or two ) to adjust to the different way of accessing the app tray or getting to my last used apps, but it was worth it!
Battery Drains Quickly. Battery hog. Even with no apps running

In general, I like my google pixel 3 xl. It mostly does what I need it to do, but... there are several little annoying things about it that surprise me given it is a google product. Most of the annoying things are related to their text message app, so maybe I need to find a new text message app to use instead of the one that comes with the phone. However, the screen also frequently stays "on" even thought it's supposed to timeout after 1 minute (nothing is running... it's just stuck on active) and I find myself having to restart the phone frequently. I also cannot download the same apps that I had on my previous Samsung phone. They're both androids... why aren't the same apps available on both? I've paid for it, I'm using it, but I will think twice about buying a google phone again going forward.

Good phone, fast boot up, wireless charging with just average camera. Pluses: wireless charging Fast boot up Photo editing software is good, can easily highlight and add text to screenshots Perfect size not too small or too big Video tools, time lapse is a cool feature. Fast processor, if something lags it is likely on the other end such as website server etc. Finger scan is good Google contacts and Gmail, Google Pay all integrates smoothly with phone, I guess this is expected because it is a Google phone but it's appreciated Most photo features are good like panoramic and timers. Google headphones that come with it are superb sound quality wise and they fit great in the ear. Screen is vivid, show alot of detail. Reception is great even indoors where others have trouble. Battery life is enough to last all day in one charge.

Phone's battery drains at lightning speed. Hi thegadgetdeals. I was happy that the phone came in smooth condition however it turned into a disappointment when I noticed that the battery drains too fast. The phone hardly lasts 2h with continued use. This was supposed to be refurbished, right? But why ship a dying phone? You guys were supposed to replace a dying battery with a new/decent one.
